standard.title: Comprehension strategies for complex and abstract ideas
standard.description: integrate comprehension strategies such as visualising, predicting, connecting, summarising, monitoring, questioning and inferring to analyse and interpret complex and abstract ideas
standard.prior_knowledge: Students use comprehension strategies to compare and contrast ideas and opinions within and between texts (AC9E9LY05). They have not yet integrated multiple comprehension strategies to analyse and interpret complex and abstract ideas.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students integrate comprehension strategies to analyse and interpret complex and abstract ideas.

nodes.label: Applying strategies to complex ideas
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can apply comprehension strategies to analyse complex ideas in texts, selecting appropriate strategies for the type of complexity encountered.
nodes.minimum_width: Apply at least two comprehension strategies to analyse a complex idea in a provided text, explaining what each strategy reveals.
nodes.typical_width: Apply a range of comprehension strategies — including visualising, questioning and inferring — to analyse complex and abstract ideas across different text types.
wider: Monitor comprehension while reading a text with complex abstract concepts (e.g. justice, identity) and use questioning and connecting strategies to build interpretation across the text
Apply comprehension strategies to interpret the role of a character archetype across a range of texts, summarising the archetype's function and analysing its importance
Use visualising and connecting strategies to interpret how abstract concepts (e.g. parenthood, freedom) are represented in visual advertising
nodes.hinge_reason: Node 2 requires students to integrate multiple strategies — a move that depends on having a working repertoire of strategies that can be applied to complex ideas. Students who cannot apply strategies individually cannot coordinate them.

response_modes.reason: Students need to accumulate fluency with multiple comprehension strategies before they can select and integrate them — practice across text types builds the repertoire needed for integrative use.

success_criteria: Applies at least two named comprehension strategies to analyse a complex idea in a text
Can explain what each strategy contributes to their understanding

nodes.label: Integrating strategies to interpret abstract ideas
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can integrate multiple comprehension strategies to interpret complex and abstract ideas, producing a developed interpretation.
nodes.minimum_width: Integrate at least two comprehension strategies to produce an interpretation of an abstract idea in a text, explaining how the strategies worked together.
nodes.typical_width: Integrate comprehension strategies to develop a sustained interpretation of complex and abstract ideas across a text, explaining how different strategies contributed to the interpretation.
wider: Interpret the representation of an abstract concept (e.g. justice, belonging) by integrating monitoring, inferring and connecting strategies across multiple texts
Apply integrated comprehension strategies to interpret abstract concepts in First Nations Australian texts, considering how prior connecting knowledge shapes interpretation
Use integrated strategies to interpret how a character archetype functions across different cultural contexts, analysing what the archetype's variation reveals

response_modes.reason: The integrative use of multiple strategies — not just applying them in sequence but coordinating them to build a cumulative interpretation — is the core challenge here and requires explicit teaching of how strategies inform each other.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Abstract concepts and character archetypes across diverse texts offer genuinely rich material for integrated comprehension — the depth achievable in tracing an abstraction like 'justice' across texts is substantial.
success_criteria: Integrates at least two comprehension strategies in producing an interpretation
Produces a developed interpretation of a complex or abstract idea supported by evidence from the text
